RESULT over the 460 method declarations in inc/Api.h:

useless. Counting parameters flags 45 methods, nearly all benign: a C++ method

the script and an rID to the C++, and the compiler cannot tell those apart

THE ORIGIN, which this bead had open. src/Status.cpp:983, in Creature::StatiOff:
    case ILLUS_DMG:
        cHP = max(cHP + s.Mag, mHP + GetAttr(A_THP));
That is min written as max. ILLUS_DMG is illusory (psychosomatic) damage. When
the illusion ends the game refunds the fake damage, and the refund must stop AT
the maximum. max() stops at no less than it, so it pays over the top by exactly
the illusory damage taken.

WHY THE ORIGINAL INVESTIGATION MISSED IT. This bead enumerated every heal site
and every A_THP grant site. The defect is neither. It is a stati-removal refund,
and it fires with no heal and no temp HP involved.

WHY LAY ON HANDS APPEARED IN BOTH REPORTS AND IS NOT THE CAUSE. Lay on Hands
clamps correctly (src/Skills.cpp:1820). It is what puts a paladin at exactly
full, which is the only state where the surplus is visible. Wounded, the same
bug just heals you to full and looks like nothing.

WHY BRIAN SAW NO MESSAGE, asked on 2026-09-04 and not evidence against the
diagnosis. ILLUS_DMG is granted by IncStatiMag with no effect id, so removal
takes Stati_RemoveInline (inc/Map.h:693), which calls StatiOff and never
StatiMessage. The 'some of your injuries are psychosomatic' line at
src/Status.cpp:1188 is unreachable for illusory damage. The refund is silent by
construction.
